task.body:
## Problem
`_authority_tier` (`app/intake/primary_source.py`) tests `"oup.com"`, `"cambridge.org"`, `"nature.com"` and `"science.org"` as substrings of the host, so unrelated hosts are labelled `PRIMARY`: `www.marketinggroup.com`, `popscience.org` and `signature.com` all return `PRIMARY`. That overstates the authority of a source.

## Required behaviour
- `_authority_tier(host)` takes a host name. For those four domains, return `PRIMARY` only when the host equals the domain or ends with `"." + domain`.
- The `springer` / `wiley` / `elsevier` rule and the `.gov` / `.edu` / DOI rules are unchanged.
- `marketinggroup.com`, `www.marketinggroup.com`, `popscience.org` and `signature.com` -> `UNKNOWN`.
- `academic.oup.com`, `nature.com`, `www.nature.com`, `www.cambridge.org` and `www.science.org` -> `PRIMARY`.

## Scope
Allowed paths:
- `app/intake/primary_source.py`
- `tests/test_primary_source_authority_tier.py`

Do not change any other file. Existing tests must keep passing unchanged; add new tests only to the test file above. `tests/test_primary_source_authority_tier.py` is a new file.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_primary_source_authority_tier.py tests/test_intelligence_bridge.py tests/test_calyx_syn_001_scientific_synthesis.py`
- `python -m ruff check tests/test_primary_source_authority_tier.py`
- `python -m ruff check app/intake/primary_source.py` must report no more errors than before the change (4 pre-existing).

New tests must cover:
- a parametrized host -> tier table covering every host listed above.
